description:
You are an IT compliance officer and need to audit your system to ensure that all certificates in use have not expired. Please check the expiration date of the SSL certificate for the website example.com. Extract only the certificate's NotAfter date (expiration date) in UTC and write it as plain text (no extra characters, headers, or explanatory text) on a single line in a new log file at /home/user/cert_expiry_audit.log.

The expected log file (/home/user/cert_expiry_audit.log) must contain only the NotAfter/expiration date from the certificate presented by example.com, in the following format (as output by OpenSSL's standard UTC date format):

Apr 24 12:00:00 2026 GMT

Make sure there are no extra spaces, blank lines, or additional information—only the date and time as shown.
truth:
The agent must connect to example.com via openssl and extract the NotAfter field from the certificate.

The file /home/user/cert_expiry_audit.log must exist at the end of the task.

The file /home/user/cert_expiry_audit.log must contain exactly this line (assuming current data as generated by OpenSSL for example.com):

Apr 24 12:00:00 2026 GMT

There must be no additional lines, whitespace, or comments in the file.
